tab.aboutBody: Kiln reads the feedback and crash reports your testers send from TestFlight, keeps a copy here, and lets your team triage them. It never deletes or changes anything in App Store Connect.
tab.aboutRequirements: Needed: the app has been distributed with TestFlight, and its App Store Connect key has the Admin, App Manager or Developer role.
tab.aboutRetention: Apple keeps feedback for about a year and crash logs for 120 days; Kiln keeps what it has read until the retention of the workspace.
